name: The way into Tempest Keep

date.label: Original Burning Crusade attunement quest era; exact date unknown

summary: With the final trial returned to A’dal, the Tempest Key is granted. Blizzard’s attunement overview identifies it as the means of entry to the Eye, the central wing of Tempest Keep in Netherstorm. The key is an access threshold, not the battle with Kael’thas. This telling ends at the gate the trials were meant to open; the fight within belongs to another story.
